description.text: This major cultivates senior applied engineering and technical talents who can adapt to the needs of national and local economic construction and industry development, master the basic theories and professional knowledge of materials science and engineering, have strong engineering practice and application ability, have a sense of innovation, sense of social responsibility, professional ethics and humanistic literacy, and can engage in research and development, process design, production and operation management of materials in the automotive industry and related fields.

duration.text: The Materials Science and Engineering at Hubei University Of Automotive Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Copy of Passport and Photo; 2.Diploma, Certificate and Transcript; 3.Bank Statement; 4.Application form 5.Physical Examination Report; 6.Police Clearance

requirements.text: High school certificate, aged between 18 and 25 for bachelor application Bachelor Diploma,aged between 20 and 35, HSK4 for master application
